title: CEM Extensions for Design Systems
description: Definitions-only, composable lifecycle fragments for Custom Elements Manifest entries. This document is not a validator for a full Custom Elements Manifest; consumers apply the relevant definition alongside their pinned CEM schema.

LifecycleFields.description: Lifecycle siblings that may be composed with a CEM entry. The fragment remains permissive so standard CEM fields and other extensions are preserved.

deprecated.description: Standard CEM deprecation marker. A string carries the human-readable deprecation message.

removal.description: Removal target: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, semver X.Y.Z, or quarter YYYY-Qn.

replacement.description: Machine-readable replacement identifier, scoped to the same CEM entity kind and owner.

AttributeExtensions.description: Composable extension fields for a CEM attribute entry. Attribute-level lifecycle and deprecated values are independent axes; this fragment remains permissive for standard CEM siblings.
